design.selection: First 12 in station-ID order with >=3000 frozen training samples per horizon; not selected by holdout results
design.development: Two expanding folds within frozen training; evaluate chosen candidate once on original selection window
design.target: Direct stage change at 1/3/6h; actual level = latest level + predicted change
limitations: Existing selection has been inspected; these are development results only.
No retraining of deployed artifacts or independent acceptance claim.
